label: Positive discharge can persist at every natural interval with finite initial stock
paraphrase: For every natural n let e=(1/2)^n. The ledger (2e,2(1/2)^(n+1),0,e/2,e/2) is admissible and e/2 is positive. Adjacent stocks match; this witnesses indefinitely positive but decreasing interval output without external energy input, not eternal steady output or metaphysical source-free power.
